title: Week 25 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “labor demand”?
options: A person who benefits from a good or action without contributing to its cost.
The judgment officials use when law leaves choices about implementation.
Employers’ willingness and ability to hire workers at different compensation levels.
A significant, broad decline in economic activity lasting more than a brief fluctuation.
questions.explanation: Labor demand means employers’ willingness and ability to hire workers at different compensation levels.
choices: A person who benefits from a good or action without contributing to its cost.
The judgment officials use when law leaves choices about implementation.
Employers’ willingness and ability to hire workers at different compensation levels.
A significant, broad decline in economic activity lasting more than a brief fluctuation.

options: Revenue minus explicit and implicit costs.
The court’s authoritative resolution of the legal issue necessary to decide the case.
An organized collection demonstrating research, reasoning, participation, revision, and reflection.
Workers’ willingness and ability to offer labor at different compensation levels.
questions.explanation: Labor supply means workers’ willingness and ability to offer labor at different compensation levels.
choices: Revenue minus explicit and implicit costs.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “collective bargaining”?
options: Negotiation between workers acting together and an employer over compensation and conditions.
A legally binding rule governing conduct within an agency’s authority.
An opponent or critic of ratification who feared centralized power and demanded stronger protections for liberty.
Application of Bill of Rights protections to states through the Fourteenth Amendment.

choices: Negotiation between workers acting together and an employer over compensation and conditions.
A legally binding rule governing conduct within an agency’s authority.

A wage difference associated with job risk, conditions, location, or nonwage characteristics.
The rate charged on eligible borrowing from Federal Reserve lending facilities.
